mapper.sql: id, name, gender, avatar, style, location, birth, intro, song_count, create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM singer
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR style LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY song_count DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO singer (name, gender, avatar, style, location, birth, intro, song_count, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{avatar}, #{style}, #{location}, #{birth}, #{intro}, #{songCount}, NOW())
